# Navigation/Breadcrumb

An accessible navigation path. Ancestors are links and the final item identifies the current page. Long paths can collapse and expand.

## Identity

- Class: `BreadcrumbComponent`
- Selector: `dl-breadcrumb`
- Kind: standalone component
- [Component source](../../../../projects/design-library/src/lib/navigation/breadcrumb.component.ts)
- [Storybook source](../../../../projects/design-library/src/lib/navigation/breadcrumb.stories.ts)

## Integration decisions

- Import the standalone BreadcrumbComponent from `@arcwell/ui` and add it to the consuming Angular component’s `imports`.
- Use `appearance` for per-instance presentation and `styleTokens` for theme tokens. Preserve the shared light and black/glass themes; use the library stylesheet.
- Configure inputs with Angular bindings for booleans, numbers, arrays and objects. Do not turn signal-backed inputs into method calls in consumer templates.
- Consult the linked story before copying a render recipe: its moduleMetadata imports, helper constants, form setup and custom props may be required.

- `appearance`: [Appearance](http://127.0.0.1:6006/?path=/story/navigation-breadcrumb-appearance--appearance) — Overrides multiple visual properties for this instance.

- `separator`: [Separator](http://127.0.0.1:6006/?path=/story/navigation-breadcrumb-configuration--separator) — Changes the visual separator between breadcrumb items. Here it is set to “Custom separator”.

- `tone`: [TonePrimary](http://127.0.0.1:6006/?path=/story/navigation-breadcrumb-variations--tone-primary) — Changes the semantic color state. Here it is set to “primary”.
- `tone`: [ToneNeutral](http://127.0.0.1:6006/?path=/story/navigation-breadcrumb-variations--tone-neutral) — Changes the semantic color state. Here it is set to “neutral”.
- `tone`: [ToneDanger](http://127.0.0.1:6006/?path=/story/navigation-breadcrumb-variations--tone-danger) — Changes the semantic color state. Here it is set to “danger”.
- `tone`: [ToneInherit](http://127.0.0.1:6006/?path=/story/navigation-breadcrumb-variations--tone-inherit) — Changes the semantic color state. Here it is set to “inherit”.
- `underline`: [UnderlineAlways](http://127.0.0.1:6006/?path=/story/navigation-breadcrumb-appearance--underline-always) — Controls whether the link underline is always visible, appears on interaction, or is hidden. Here it is set to “always”.
- `underline`: [UnderlineHover](http://127.0.0.1:6006/?path=/story/navigation-breadcrumb-appearance--underline-hover) — Controls whether the link underline is always visible, appears on interaction, or is hidden. Here it is set to “hover”.

- `disabled`: [DisabledTrue](http://127.0.0.1:6006/?path=/story/navigation-breadcrumb-configuration--disabled-true) — Prevents user interaction. This example has it turned on.

- `linkCurrent`: [LinkCurrentFalse](http://127.0.0.1:6006/?path=/story/navigation-breadcrumb-configuration--link-current-false) — Allows the current breadcrumb item to remain a link when it has a destination. This example has it turned off.
